notes: Records transcribed from MCArchive pages. Hashes are SHA-256 provenance/integrity values and do not authorize execution.
Only records with an exact filename and SHA-256 are included. Minecraft version IDs are normalized to the Phase C release catalog where necessary.

MCArchive page SHA-256 values are source-declared and have not been locally verified against artifact bytes. Artifact URLs retain their observed HTTP/HTTPS scheme; HTTP-only artifacts are denied for download, and all artifacts are denied execution.
